title: Ben Bought Paints
lines: Ben went to the shop with his gran.
He had six dollars in his hand.
He thought he would get a red kite.
He had wanted that kite for a long time.
But then he saw a box of paints.
Ben stood there for a long while.
He picked up the kite, then set it down.
In the end he bought the paints.
He brought them home and started painting.
At first his art was just spots.
He thought he had made a bad pick.
But then he painted a big red kite.
Now his room is full of bright art.

questions.ask: What did Ben nearly get first?
questions.listenFor: A red kite. He changed his mind when he saw the box of paints.

questions.ask: What did Ben paint after the spots?
questions.listenFor: A big red kite. He got his kite in the end, just not the one from the shop.

questions.ask: Would you pick the kite or the paints? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either choice is fine. The why is the part worth hearing.
